scope: Finite transition objective ablation only. No fresh data, no perception/architecture/query changes, no automatic D or adoption.

objectives.latent: Each target alpha*Z, same target/root/span weights; alpha frozen by initial AB gradient calibration
objectives.Z: raw4x64 latent MSE, no query normalization

calibration.data: First32update indices0..31 of each fixedseed0/1 schedule;64ABbatches,16include multistep; assert every used pair split=train
